book.title: Endgame Strategy
book.author: Mikhail Shereshevsky
book.edition: New In Chess 2022, revised and expanded

method: Agent read embedded source text and independently inspected the six starting diagram images before any provider call; python-chess validated each starting position, the complete printed mainline and selected branch paths.
notes: All ranges are one-based physical PDF pages, not the table-of-contents page numbers.
Fullmove numbers and side to move follow the printed score. Halfmove clocks are initialized to zero, not recovered historical clocks.

mainline_san is chess-authority-normalized; check and annotation typography is not copied blindly. Compare starting piece placement, turn, castling, en-passant and printed move number; do not require historical halfmove clocks.
after_mainline_plies is the exact parent after playing this many mainline plies; zero is the initial diagram. Match within the named game and source range, never by a same-FEN node in any game.
There are other printed nested variations beyond these selected checks. Their omission must not be concealed by claiming this file is exhaustive.
Each final page has the next game's title only. Preserve it as text if appropriate; do not invent a third playable score or require its absent moves.
Reference data is for evaluation only. Do not inject these FENs or transcribed lines into production model requests to make the trial pass.
No DeepSeek request or live website task was created while preparing this reference.

Visual re-audit on 2026-10-03 corrected Game 81 White king from g1 to g2 in the independent answer key; the printed diagram visibly places it on g2. The previous reference allowed the same short SAN line, so legality alone did not catch this error.
